title: docs(getting-started): add a getting started guide to react-is doc
body:
This PR is mainly done for providing the getting started. Along the way I had change / tweak a few things (that's why there are other files modified). Amongst the different other changes:

* The sidebar contains the title of the page
* The sidebar is smarter and adapts on the content of the navgroup or the document (if either of them contains only one element, this level is discarded)
* The sidebar is a tad wider

While the content of the getting started is mostly done, I need you:

* can you review the [content itself](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/blob/d26ab3986c9c3b0421291c9db33f7e36cf12746d/docgen/src/gettingstarted.md), make sure I talked every important and I didn't go into too much details for others?
* there is no live examples yet. The getting started of the helper have its samples on codepen, but I'm not sure we want to go this. What do you suggest?
